description: The customer's live Insurability Level (I-0 to I-4) worked out from their sealed AI behaviour over the last 30 days: records verify and no receipts missing (I-1), humans review flags with real reading time (I-2), an armed enforcement loop and kill switch (I-3), agent payments need approval (I-4). Shows what is holding them back and how to fix it, and which insurers they share it with. Read-only.
name: sebbi_insurer_level
title: Live insurability level
